CONTACT / THE REGISTRY

How to reach
the registry.

If we are conflicted, we will tell you before you tell us anything.

Write to us. We have deliberately not put a form on this page, because a form invites you to describe your dispute to us before we have run a conflict check — and if we turn out to be conflicted, neither of us wants that information to have been sent.

So: tell us who you are and what kind of matter it is. Not the facts. We will run a conflict check, tell you whether we can act, and only then ask for the file.
